ordinary_review: The original complete fourth reserve controls L2 T and L2 (QT prime) prime with the original normalization. Integrating from the regular bolt supplies the global Holder estimate. Averaging on a variable interval is a proof device and imposes no physical boundary.

The optimized radius must lie in the actual half interval. The proof applies to core differences, so uniform completion retains the actual paired mass/log domain and regular flux, without a smooth surrogate.

The point comparison enters both the complete two-row bolt map and the full retained-operator source and Hessian error. These are evaluated together; no isolated component improvement is presented as a complete estimate.
All source, regulator, spectrum, contacts, finite returns and transport depth remain unchanged. The scalar trace is unchanged. No unit or admission norm is changed.

The retained-inverse transport error is distinct from an actual numerical solve and from errors of polynomial inverse applications. Higher source, graph, phase, physical comparisons and every actual coupled entry remain unknown.

All candidate-degree output allowances are conditional ceilings, not coefficients. Neither a passing bolt-tail slice nor a passing transport slice closes the coupled estimate or justifies adopting a degree.
